name: OUSLEY, HARPER GRACE

case.surgeon_notes: Nasal tube please. Radiographs to be taken under GA. Approx 10-12 teeth to treat, 2 extractions (#K, #T).

Selective eater: chicken nuggets, plain crackers, applesauce pouches, chocolate milk

psh: Auditory brainstem response test under sedation

notes: East Tennessee Children's Hospital (scanned sedation record)

Sedated ABR, age 3. Attempted oral midazolam 0.5 mg/kg - spat out. Mask induction attempted with sevoflurane - extremely combative, required 3 staff, desaturation to 88% with breath-holding, recovered. Maintained on sevo via mask. Emergence: severe agitation 30 min. Recommendation: consider IM premedication for future anesthetics.

Age 5, 18.6 kg, ASD level 3, for MRI brain. Hx combative mask induction 2022. Parents request IM premed. Plan: ketamine 4 mg/kg IM (75 mg), no anticholinergic, given in mother's lap in preop room with iPad. Then IV after sedated, propofol infusion, natural airway with nasal cannula + capnography. -- Addendum 1130: Ketamine 75 mg IM L deltoid by RN with mother holding; sedated in 4 min, IV 22g placed on 1st attempt, transported. Propofol 200-250 mcg/kg/min, no airway intervention. Mild secretions, suctioned. Emergence calm in dim room with mother, no agitation. Discharged 1330. Excellent plan - recommend repeating.

Well 7 yo. Wt 21.6 kg (40th %ile), ht 120 cm. Asthma mild intermittent, albuterol rarely. Selective eater, on iron, ferritin improving. Constipation controlled on PEG. Behavior: ABA progressing. Dental: overdue - referral to pediatric dentistry. Flu shot today declined (needle distress) - will try at school clinic.

L cheek swelling x 2 days, not eating. Extensive caries, abscess #K with buccal swelling, #T mobile with fistula. Unable to complete exam - combative, 2 staff. Amoxicillin 45 mg/kg/day x 10 d. Refer for full-mouth rehab under GA. Parents agree.

7 yo F with ASD, early childhood caries, 2 abscessed primary molars (swelling resolved after amoxicillin). Plan full-mouth rehab under GA with nasal intubation. PMH: ASD level 3, mild intermittent asthma, iron deficiency, constipation. PSH: sedated ABR 2022, MRI 2024 under GA. Meds: albuterol PRN, PEG, melatonin, iron, MVI. NKDA. Exam (limited): alert, nonverbal, avoids touch. Lungs clear. Heart RRR. Dentition as above. A/P: OR 10/27. Mother requests same IM ketamine premed as MRI - will forward to anesthesia.
Child life referral placed. Mother asks for first-case or quiet room; prolonged waiting increases meltdowns. Mother states Harper had a cold 2 wk ago, now better. Scheduled 1000 (first available).

Phone screen with mother. Wt approx 22 kg. Asthma: last albuterol 10/14 with mild cough, no current symptoms, no steroids in past year, no hospitalizations. No recent URI symptoms. Requests IM ketamine premed with mother present like 11/2024 and to arrive as late as possible. Plan per Dr. Castile: mother present for IM premed; child life to meet in quiet room; arrive 0900. Can have chocolate milk until 0600? Clarified - milk is not a clear liquid: NPO solids/milk after 0200, clear apple juice until 0900.
Reminder call. Arrival 0900. Last solids/chocolate milk by 0200; clears (apple juice, water) until 0900. Give albuterol 2 puffs AM if possible. Bring iPad and weighted blanket.
